action_scope: Same full45-input actor and emitted-action clipping as corrected pilot. Fresh original-base actor initialization; fresh critic and optimizer. No import from either prior pilot.
change: Longer fixed512-update training and sagittal mirror policy regularization. No augmented PPO returns because terrain is not mirrored. This compound change is not a causal ablation of symmetry alone.
training_data: Unchanged fixed2flat+3rough101+3rough107 columns;128 environments. No reference gait, phase reward, height input, teacher or old replay.
selection: Final checkpoint after exactly512 updates only. No best-epoch choice, retry or automatic resume of failed training.
evaluation: Freeze final checkpoint and original base on phase-local matched new seed239 starts;5x2000 task plus2x1000 flat per policy/terrain. Same original task criteria and safety limits.
acceptance: Pilot supports independent replication only with paired completion gain on both terrains and eligible flat retention. Stable goal still needs>=9/10 per terrain across independent learning runs, repeated gains, new-development terrain and gait evidence.
retention_rule: Full1000-step windows,750steady samples, no fall/reset/safety violation; meanXY<=max(1.1*base,base+.005), eachX/Y<=base+.01 m/s.
failure_policy: Keep every failure and charged/uncertain control. Preserve both prior pilots and their separate evaluation costs. No replacement starts.
engineering_gate: Reflection involution, clipping compatibility, physical joint reflection and actual RSL mirror-loss update must pass before simulation. Existing environment smoke covers unchanged physics; first failed training attempt is charged and not retried.
cost_review: New2097152 training plus48000 evaluation; prior incompatible524288 and corrected524288 plus its actual evaluation remain separately counted. Not equal-resource superiority evidence.
